title.en: Guangsu Cloud Unveils Snooker 147 Lifetime 247GB Package: Pay Once, Keep Forever

description.zh: 针对轻度办公与常备救急用户，光速云特别推出致敬斯诺克147经典套餐，定价147元享有247GB永久流量，不设月度重置与过期时间。
description.en: Guangsu Cloud launches the Snooker 147 plan: ¥147 for 247GB of permanent dedicated data with zero monthly resets.
